notes.content: [p]Version v1.4.9 Patch Notes:[/p][p]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/p][p]* Significantly improved the bot AI's responsiveness to hazards in Dissolving Depths[/p][p]* The 'Round Multiplier' when hosting a Minigame Lobby can now be set to values below 1 to allow for minigames to optionally have only a single round[/p][p]* Changed the default FPS cap to 60, down from 144. notes.title: Update v1.4.3 - Custom Lobbies go Free!
notes.content:
With the v1.4.3 update players can now host public lobbies with their friends and other players regardless of if any of them own the [b]Arcade Pass[/b] DLC. Players can now play over 30 minigames completely free with their friends! We hope this encourages more people to hop on and give the full Minigame Game a shot!

To reduce potential instances of [i]creative[/i] lobby names, custom lobbies can no longer be renamed if the host does not own the [b]Arcade Pass[/b] DLC.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Version v1.4.3 Patch Notes:

New Additions
* Custom lobbies can now be hosted and joined by anyone!

Bug Fixes & Improvements
* Fixed a few minor sound concurrency issues that would occur in a few minigames

notes.title: Update v1.4.0 - Minigame Game goes Free-To-Play!
notes.content:
With the new v1.4.0 update Minigame Game is becoming Free-To-Play! As of today players are now free to join their friends and others online on our official servers, or host their own custom (public or private) lobbies with the new [b]Arcade Pass[/b] DLC!

The new [b]Arcade Pass[/b] DLC being introduced with this update is what we consider the "Full Game" purchase. This pass allows players to both use cosmetics and host custom lobbies. These lobbies can be joined by any number (up to the max player limit of 16) of free or [b]Arcade Pass[/b] owning players. There are no plans to lock future minigames behind any new DLC purchases and this DLC purchase is simply our way to make the game a lot more accessible to groups of friends at a much lower cost! 

If you'd like to try Minigame Game with others prior to any purchase, we've also launched two official dedicated servers with our previous update that can now be joined by any F2P player or [b]Arcade Pass[/b] owner!

Already purchased Minigame Game prior to this F2P change? You'll receive the [b]Arcade Pass[/b] DLC for free and there will be no noticeable in-game changes for you other than a larger player base! We also don't want to forget the fact that you guys helped Minigame Game make it this far. We are looking into introducing a new cosmetic for all of our early adopters prior to this F2P change and are open to ideas over on our Steam Community forums!

We hope this gives the chance for more people to enjoy Minigame Game!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Version v1.4.0 Patch Notes:

New Additions
* Players can now join lobbies and official servers for free
* Cosmetics are now locked behind the [b]Arcade Pass[/b] DLC
* Hosting a customized lobby now requires the [b]Arcade Pass[/b] DLC

Bug Fixes & Improvements
* Updated some UI elements to account for Free-To-Play
* Fixed minor Z-fighting of materials in a few areas

notes.title: Update v1.3.5
notes.content:
Version v1.3.5 Patch Notes:

[u][b]New Additions[/b][/u]
 * Added two brand new Dedicated Minigame Lobby servers. One with a player limit of 10 with bots, and one with a player limit of 16 with no bots. These lobbies will remain running 24/7 to help players find each other!

[u][b]Minigame Changes[/b][/u]
* [i]Lobby[/i]: Added more visual flair to the lobby
* [i]Forbidden Ritual[/i]: Fixed a bug where the ending sound didn't always play correctly
* [i]End Lobby[/i]: Increased the volume of the 'Level Up' sound by a small amount
 
[u][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/u]
 * The Audio Options Menu now displays the active Input (microphone) device being used
 * Updated the default avatar used by streaming mode and by bots

notes.title: Update v1.3.0
notes.content:
Version v1.3.0 Patch Notes:

[u][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/u]
 * Fixed the "Best of the Best" achievement not reliably unlocking. This achievement will retroactively unlock for players that have achieved it the next time they finish a minigame session
 * Minor performance optimizations to minigame actors
 * Bots now abide by the "Max Players" count when hosting. Updated the hosting menu text to reflect this
 * Clamped the minimum Player/Bot count to 2

notes.title: Update v1.2.0
notes.content:
Version v1.2.0 Patch Notes:

[u][b]Minigame Changes[/b][/u]
* [i]Lobby[/i]: Fixed two minigames missing their 'Bot Supported' icons
* [i]The Grind[/i]: Removed leftover text from an unused gameplay mechanic
 
[u][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/u]
 * Improved player, bot, and AI movement replication performance by about 10%. This was achieved by using UE4's vector quantization and optimizations to the replicated movement data
 * Fixed fatal kills from damage volumes (such as lava, spikes, falling, etc) not playing their damage effects
 * Fixed a rare bug where the minigame's Level Script Actor could fail to replicate before the minigame's world had called BeginPlay which would cause certain actors to fail to initialize correctly on the client
 * Improved physics responsiveness on the client by 33% by reducing the buffer stored before the client starts simulating the physics locally
 * Fixed the gamma setting not working correctly
 * Made the "Enable Bots" UI a little more clear
 * Bots now ignore the Max Player count and will fill slots up to 8 players

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
Minigame Game's v1.1.0 update brings both big and small improvements in response to feedback we've received on release!

Version v1.1.0 Patch Notes:

[u][b]New Additions[/b][/u]
 * Added the option for the host to skip a minigame from the in-game menu

[u][b]Minigame Changes[/b][/u]
 * Adjusted the player's max health in the Moonstone Grab minigame
 * Adjusted the damage dealt by shotgunners in the Moonstone Grab minigame
 * Players now respawn quicker in the Moonstone Grab minigame
 
[u][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/u]
 * Minor UI updates

notes.title: Update v1.0.0 - Release Update!
notes.content:
Minigame Game's v1.0.0 Release Update brings our 36th minigame, a new achievement and cosmetic to unlock, bug fixes, sound improvements, and more!

Version v1.0.0 Patch Notes:

[u][b]New Minigames[/b][/u]
* [b][i]Dissolving Depths[/i][/b]: Don't stand still too long in this new minigame where the acid eats away any objects players stand on! Use your shotgun to keep other players away while staying out of the acid yourself!

[u][b]New Additions[/b][/u]
 * Added an achievement and unlockable cosmetic for winning two minigame sessions in a row
 * Added a low ammo noise to most pistols, shotguns, ARs, and snipers
 
[u][b]Minigame Changes[/b][/u]
 * Adjusted the points awarded in Ornament Bash
 * The in-game leader list is now displayed in The Range minigame
 
[u][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/u]
 * Fixed a rare bug where players would get stuck attempting to rejoin the server they just left for 60 seconds
 * Minor UI optimizations for servers with higher player counts
 
Thank you to all of our early adopters who helped make this release be the best it can!

notes.title: Update v0.9.8
notes.content:
The new v0.9.8 update brings a new holiday themed minigame as well as some minor optimizations and other improvements!

[u][b]New Minigames[/b][/u]
* [b][i]Ornament Bash[/i][/b]: Smash some oranments while you skate around the arena with your friends or bots in this new holiday themed minigame!

[u][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/u]
 * Slightly increased the size of the blood impact particle effect to make it more noticeable
 * Fixed some minigames having geometry from outside the minigame clipping into the arena
 * Fixed rare instances of players jittering on geometry with complex collision

notes.title: Update v0.9.6
notes.content:
The new v0.9.6 update brings even faster gameplay with a new 'quick reload' system, new achievements and cosmetics to unlock, and many more fixes and improvements!

Version 0.9.6 Patch Notes:

[u][b]New Additions[/b][/u]
 * Added a new melee animation 'slowdown' that occurs when swings impact something
 * Implemented a new 'quick reload' system where weapons that reload only a single shell/bullet at a time can now have their reload sped up by pressing the reload button again at the correct time during the cycle
 * Added two new cosmetics and their respective achievements to unlock them

[u][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/u]
 * Adjusted various attenuation distances for weapon sounds and actions to improve distant sound falloff
 * Fixed weapons on a few minigames not starting with their correct ammo count
 * Fixed ties in 'Last To Survive'-style minigames not awarding the tied players the same score
 * Minor UI and UI sound improvements
 * Fixed the lobby clock displaying the wrong time
 * Improved some audio loops
 * Fixed a few instances of gameplay effects not being reliably replicated when they were important to gameplay
 * Backend minigame system improvements and optimizations
 * Updated the main lobby with better visuals

[u][b]Minigame Changes[/b][/u]
 * Improved AI functionality in 'The Range' minigame

notes.title: Update v0.9.3
notes.content:
The new v0.9.3 update brings gameplay improvements, sound fixes, and adds in some missing lobby information!

* Bots now make use of a new prioritization system for determining their next movement location
* Added in some missing "bot supported" icons to the newer minigames in the lobby

[u][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/u]

* Updated a few Minigame descriptions
* Fixed some gameplay sounds not playing when the music was disabled

notes.title: Update v0.9.2
notes.content:
The new v0.9.2 update brings improved shader caching, a new main menu and cosmetic UI, as well as new achievements and cosmetics to unlock!

Version 0.9.2 Patch Notes:

[u][b]New Additions[/b][/u]
* Players can now see the visuals of their equipped cosmetics in the cosmetic UI
* Added 5 new cosmetics and their respective achievements to unlock them!

[u][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/u]
* Fixed a bug where achievements were not awarded if they were completed in the last round of a minigame
* Remade parts of the main menu and cosmetic UI to better support smaller screens and improve accessibility
* Adjusted font sizes throughout various areas of the UI
* Fixed the 'Executioner Hat' cosmetic not using the correct material
* Fixed instances of assets being missed by the shader caching system

notes.title: Update v0.9.1
notes.content:
The new v0.9.1 update brings improved controller support, UI improvements, and a new 'One in the Chamber' minigame variation!

-

Version 0.9.1 Patch Notes:

[u][b]New Minigames[/b][/u]
* [b][i]Dev Tag[/i][/b]: Grab your light gun and fight it out in this new laser tag inspired 'One in the Chamber' minigame variation!

[u][b]New Additions[/b][/u]
* Shaders will now be precompiled in the main menu (This is a work in progress and may not catch all shaders quite yet. This can be turned off in the options menu)
* Added controller icons, configurable acceleration and deadzones, and optional aim assist that is supported by all minigames

[u][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/u]
* Improved replication of player footsteps and fixed instances of player's not replicating their falling impact noise
* Fixed movement acceleration being affected by the player's frame rate in rare circumstances
* Fixed 2D sounds played through gameplay triggers not playing to the local client
* Improved replication performance of some minigame actors
* Fixed minigames not always overriding the death camera location as intended
* Physics impact noises will no longer play after a round has ended
* Fixed AI ignoring BSP brushes for line of sight checks
* Fixed weapons not overriding the player's FOV when using ADS
* Improved various font sizes throughout areas of the UI

[u][b]Minigame Changes[/b][/u]
* Adjusted the levels in which some minigames are unlocked in the lobby

notes.title: Update v0.9.0 - Co-op Update
notes.content:
The new v0.9.0 Minigame Game update adds two new co-op minigames and one new PvP minigame bringing the minigame count up to 33!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339032/c2a5699a1e030635f05c4a37ff07b5a3f7ff34d1.gif[/img]

Version 0.9.0 Patch Notes:

[u][b]New Minigames[/b][/u]
* [b][i]Forbidden Ritual[/i][/b]: Join forces to protect the ritual from incoming enemies in this cooperative wave survival minigame!
* [b][i]Elevated Encounter[/i][/b]: Engage in a PvP showdown where quick reflexes are key as you ascend on platforms, progressively losing cover along the way!
* [b][i]Moonstone Grab[/i][/b]: Team up with friends and grab as many moonstones as possible within the time limit while fending off the wandering enemies!

[u][b]New Additions[/b][/u]
* Added a ladder climbing symbol to the HUD
* Added support for minigame specific equipment (items/armor on players)
* Weapons can now alert AI in minigames that have free-roaming AI
* Minigames can now end with a cutscene
* Minigames can now override the player's movement

[u][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/u]
* Fixed AI jittering in place when they had no goal in mind
* Further improved AI pathing and fixed instances of AI getting stuck in certain corners
* Fixed bots teleporting at the beginning of a round in some minigames
* Optimized AI and bot functionality to support minigames with larger AI counts
* Fixed third-person reload sounds not working for weapons that loaded individual bullets
* Improved third-person animation performance
* Fixed instances of the audio cutting out when too many sounds were playing at once. Reworked all sounds to be in their respective sound concurrency groups
* Improved AI enemy prioritization for visible enemies
* Improved spawn point prioritization in FFA minigames
* Fixed AI death messages not always displaying correctly

[u][b]Minigame Changes[/b][/u]
* [i]Scrapbook[/i]: Fixed player trails missing in EZMode

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339032/ffab2aadc95a92c1ce320bae4384fa707f479d8e.gif[/img]
